title: US Senate passes energy bill requiring AI data centres to pay more for grid upgrades
summary_full: The US Senate has passed the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026, designed to bolster energy infrastructure significantly. This new law mandates that large AI data centers play a larger role in funding electricity grid improvements. Environmental advocates raise alarms over potential threats to regulatory controls and tribal rights.
